 Sombr You Are The Reason Tour: Dates & Tickets 2026
 October 25, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Sombr’s You Are The Reason Tour is a 75-show global run across North America, Oceania, and Europe from July 2026 through July 2027.
 The North American arena leg opens September 29, 2026 in Vancouver and concludes with back-to-back Madison Square Garden shows on November 23–24, 2026.
 Support acts rotate by leg and include Interpol, The Last Dinner Party, Tom Odell, Dove Cameron, King Princess, Suki Waterhouse, and others.
 Strong demand has driven multiple added dates across North America, Europe, and Australia, including five London O2 Arena shows.
 OnesToWatch Live tracks new dates, added shows, and changing ticket availability across the run.

 With the 2026 North American arena leg underway, the tour expands internationally in 2027. The next section outlines the Mexico, Oceania, European, and UK dates that extend the run into the following summer.
 2027 International Legs And Festival Dates
 The 2027 international legs take the tour to Mexico, Oceania, mainland Europe, and the UK and Ireland. Sombr announced the international extension of the You Are The Reason Tour on September 1, 2026, adding Australia, New Zealand, and Europe/UK dates for 2027, while the Mexico City dates belonged to the previously confirmed North American leg. These shows are announced and on sale, and ticket availability and on-sale timing vary by market.
 Mexico City (January 2027): Two shows at Pepsi Center WTC on January 29 and 30, 2027, with King Princess as support.
 Oceania (April 2027): The Australia and New Zealand leg, presented by Frontier Touring, includes Adelaide Entertainment Centre (April 13), Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne (April 15, 16, 17), Brisbane Entertainment Centre (April 19, 20), Afterpay Arena in Sydney (April 22, 23, 24), and Spark Arena in Auckland (April 27). All shows are licensed all-ages. Sombr added extra nights in Melbourne, Brisbane, and Sydney for the April 2027 Australian leg due to strong presale demand, initially adding second shows in Melbourne and Sydney and a second Brisbane show, with third nights in Melbourne and Sydney added later.
 Europe — Mainland (May 2027): The European arena leg opens May 8 at Unity Arena in Oslo and runs through Avicii Arena in Stockholm (May 9), Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki (May 11), Royal Arena in Copenhagen (May 13), Barclays Arena in Hamburg (May 14), AFAS Dome in Antwerp (May 16), Uber Arena in Berlin (May 18), O2 Arena in Prague (May 19), Accor Arena in Paris (May 22), Lanxess Arena in Cologne (May 23 and 24), Hallenstadion in Zürich (May 27), Olympiahalle in Munich (May 28), Wiener Stadthalle in Vienna (May 29), and Ziggo Dome in Amsterdam (May 31 and June 1). Ravyn Lenae and Jessie Mazin support across the mainland European dates.
 UK And Ireland (June 2027): Outdoor and arena dates include Malahide Castle in Dublin (June 15), Ormeau Park in Belfast as part of Belsonic (June 17), Bellahouston Park in Glasgow as part of Glasgow Summer Sessions (June 19), and five nights at The O2 Arena in London (June 21, 22, 24, 25, and 29). Suki Waterhouse supports the London dates.
 Festivals (2027): Rock Werchter on July 4, 2027 (Main Stage, Werchter, Belgium); Open’er Festival in Kosakowo, Poland (July 1); Main Square Festival in Arras, France (July 2); and I-Days Milano in Milan on July 14, 2027, the tour’s final announced date ; Wikipedia lists the venue as Ippodromo Snai La Maura, while I-Days and Ticketmaster list it as Ippodromo SNAI San Siro.
 2026 Pre-Arena Dates (Past): The tour opened with a July 22, 2026 show at Pepsi Center WTC in Mexico City (King Princess opening), followed by Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado on July 26 and 27, 2026. Festival appearances in 2026 included Lollapalooza (Chicago, July 30), Osheaga (Montreal, August 1), Sziget (Budapest, August 11), Rock en Seine (Paris, August 26), and Reading and Leeds (August 29–30).
 Who Is Opening For Sombr On The You Are The Reason Tour?
 The You Are The Reason Tour uses a rotating slate of support acts that shifts by leg and region. The North American leg features eight support acts on select dates: Interpol, The Last Dinner Party, Tom Odell, Dove Cameron, Balu Brigada, King Princess, The Hellp, and Hannah Jadagu.
 On the North American arena routing, support assignments break down by region. Interpol was one of the opening acts, alongside The Hellp, for Sombr’s You Are The Reason Tour kickoff at Rogers Arena in Vancouver on September 29, 2026 . The Hellp supported Sombr on the Pacific Northwest dates (Seattle on October 1 and Portland on October 2) as well as San Diego (October 13) and Oklahoma City (October 16), among other select dates on the You Are The Reason arena tour. Tom Odell supported the California swing from Sacramento through San Diego. His 2012 single “Another Love” accumulated over 3.4 billion Spotify streams as of May 2025 after a 2022 TikTok-driven revival tied to its use as an anthem in support of Ukraine . The Last Dinner Party, winners of the BRITs Rising Star Award in 2024 and the BBC Sound of 2024, handled the longest stretch of Sombr’s You Are The Reason Tour, opening the southern and midwest dates from Oklahoma City on October 16 through Chicago on November 4, 2026 (the Glendale, AZ date on October 14 was opened by Tom Odell). Dove Cameron takes over as opener from the November 6 Indianapolis show through the two-night Madison Square Garden finale on November 23 and 24 in New York City, with Hannah Jadagu appearing on select dates in the back half of the run. Balu Brigada , a New Zealand alt-pop act, joined the early Pacific Northwest dates.
 For the 2027 international legs, King Princess returns for the Mexico City dates. Ravyn Lenae and Jessie Mazin support the mainland European arena run. Suki Waterhouse joins for the UK and Ireland dates, including the London O2 Arena shows.
 This opener strategy turns the bill into a curated snapshot of adjacent scenes. Arriving early to any date on this run means encountering an act with its own established audience and catalog.
 Tour Patterns And Takeaways
 The You Are The Reason Tour marks a clear step up in venue size and global reach for Sombr. His debut album I Barely Know Her (2025), co-produced with Tony Berg, put three songs on the August 16, 2025-dated Billboard Hot 100 simultaneously: “Undressed” (No. 28), “Back to Friends” (No. 30), and “12 to 12” (No. 95). The album also earned a Grammy nomination for Best New Artist, setting up an arena-scale touring cycle.
 Demand-driven additions have shaped the tour from its first announcement. Extra Denver and New York City shows were added two days after the initial April 13, 2026 announcement. The September 1, 2026 international expansion added Oceania, Europe, and Mexico City. On September 2, 2026, second shows were announced for London, Amsterdam, Cologne, Melbourne, and Sydney due to high demand. London subsequently expanded to five O2 Arena nights, an unusual volume for a debut-album artist.
 Pricing on the North American leg reflects that demand profile. A same-day snapshot at Rogers Arena in Vancouver showed the cheapest available Ticketmaster listings at C$135.25 plus fees, with pit tickets near C$250. Those figures represent live secondary inventory on the secondary market and fluctuate daily, so check the official Ticketmaster links above for current availability.
